html:
Upande Livestock · Operations

Operations

Record every farm activity — each operation in its own tab.

Herd Feeding Programme
Pick a herd. The TMR scales with head count, every line is checked against the feed stores first, and the whole batch is issued to that herd in the same action.
Record Milking Session
Creates and submits a Milk Recording (posts the milk Stock Entry and revenue Journal Entry).
—
Record Herd Movement
Moves an animal to a new herd and updates head counts.
Record Drying Off
Marks the end of a lactation for an animal.
Record Calving / Birth
Creates a Calving event and, for live births, an Animal record + Birth event per calf.
Tag / NameSexBirth wt (kg)Herd
Record Service / Insemination
Records an Livestock Event only — no stock entry, no semen-straw inventory.
Ready for service
Post-partum animals cleared to re-breed.
Loading…
Record Pregnancy Diagnosis
Auto-links the most recent pending service for the animal.
Pregnancy checks due
Submitted services awaiting a diagnosis.
Loading…
Record Husbandry
Vaccination and Deworming issue their drugs out of the drug store as a Material Issue. Dehorning and Hoof Trimming are procedures and take no stock.
DrugQty / animalTotalDosageBatchWithdrawal (d)
Record Abortion
Closes out the animal's open pregnancy and restarts the service clock. The pregnancy is auto-linked — an abortion with none on file is still recordable.
Record Weight
Creates a Livestock Weight Record. Previous weight and daily gain are derived on save.
Record Check Up
A routine clinical check (Livestock Diagnosis). Appears on the animal's timeline as a Check Up event.
DrugQtyDosageBatchWithdrawal (d)
Open Health Case
For an animal that needs treatment over time. Record each round of treatment in the card alongside.
Add Treatment
Today's round on an open case. The drugs leave the store as the treatment is recorded — a case treated over five days posts five issues, not one.
DrugQtyDosageRouteWithdrawal (d)
Record Disposal
Permanent. The animal is disabled and drops out of every dropdown, its herd headcount is recomputed, and the linked asset is sold or scrapped. History is kept.
name: Livestock Operations
